Rebecca / Anil / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the RFI. Please find our finalized responses and supporting artifacts attached. Below is an executive summary of the answers and pointers to the attached files. The attached PDF is a direct, question-by-question RFI completion. The CSV provides a machine-readable catalog extract for your ingestion.

Executive summary:
- Machine-readable catalog: included (model_catalog_export.csv). Fields: model_id, model_name, architecture, quantization, release_date, license_label, provenance_url, semantic_version, checksum_sha256.
- Licensing: each model in the catalog includes an upstream license mapping and a license_label column that flags any additional vendor restrictions. For open-models we map to upstream licenses (e.g., Apache-2.0, MIT); for vendor-sourced weights we include vendor_license and a short caveat text.
- Provenance evidence: we publish versioned model cards (human + machine readable), signed checksums, and a provenance README that outlines available artifacts. For customers under NDA we can provide dataset manifests or more detailed training provenance under a separate evidence pack.
- Version pinning & updates: customers may pin to exact semantic versions or commit hashes. Pinned versions are excluded from automatic rollouts and remain available for the duration of the customer subscription (or until mutually agreed decommission). We provide notification channels: email + webhook + Console alerts. Update categories: minor/patch (opt-in auto-apply), major (scheduled upgrade window), and security-critical (immediate notice + hotfix).
